name: Gaze + Pinch
summary: Gaze identifies an intended object and a pinch confirms the action.
howItWorks: Look at a candidate target, then pinch to select it.
advantages: Hands-busy contexts and lightweight XR input.
limitations: May suffer from Midas-touch effects without deliberate confirmation.
